def solve(case):
    edges = case["edges"]
    communities = case["communities"]
    resolution = case["resolution"]

    # Build adjacency and node degree
    adj = {}
    degree = {}
    for u,v,w in edges:
        if u not in adj: adj[u] = {}
        if v not in adj: adj[v] = {}
        adj[u][v] = adj[u].get(v,0) + w
        adj[v][u] = adj[v].get(u,0) + w
        degree[u] = degree.get(u,0) + w
        degree[v] = degree.get(v,0) + w
    total_weight = sum(w for _,_,w in edges)
